intersections.note: irregular crossing; point is the centre of the four block corners (1404,1478), (975,1637), (1200,1946), (1671,1782), on Queen City's centreline. Harrison bends here: the NW leg (about 62 ft between faces, drawn only to x about 500-970, toward sheet 511) runs WNW, the 75 ft leg runs SSE; the NW leg's centreline meets Queen City about 95 px east of the SSE leg's, so Harrison jogs slightly across Queen City. The Harrison water pipe runs on through the crossing (curving), which is why the NW leg is taken as Harrison
Pinetree St. (about 40 ft) ends at Queen City's north side; Pine Alley leaves the south side on the same line, so this point and the Pine Alley point are the same crossing
Pine Alley (10 ft) ends at Queen City's south side, in line with Pinetree St. (same crossing)
Lawnway ends at Queen City's north side (top edge of sheet); the Lawnway water pipe meets the Queen City pipe at about (4945,430)
Lawn Alley (10 ft) ends at Queen City's south side, offset about 65 px east of Lawnway
Pine Alley ends at the north face of the Lick Run Alley corridor (see notes on how the corridor is read); point on the corridor centreline

Lawn Alley ends at the north face (line P) of the Lick Run Alley corridor; point on the centreline of the whole corridor P-R. If only the labelled 15 ft band is taken as the alley, Lawn Alley stops at an unmarked 20 ft strip just north of it and this point moves about 70 px SSE (5385,1574)

APPROXIMATE (about +-40 px in y): Beekman's west face is at x about 6350 here and its east face is beyond the paper edge (x about 6485), so Beekman's centre is taken 20 ft east of the west face (about 18 px from the paper edge). y is the centre of the whole corridor mouth (line P at 1015 to the flared lot corner at 1377); if only the labelled band Q-R counts, the point is about (6470,1265)
Beekman (40 ft) ends at Harrison's north side, at the Fire Co. No. 21 corner (lot 1500/2201). Same crossing as sheet 505 (4894,421)

Westwood (60 ft) joins Harrison's south side at a shallow angle (about 25 deg), opening into a wide mouth between the truncated corner at (3077,3520) and the lot 1529 corner (4084,3547); point is where the Westwood centreline meets the Harrison centreline. Because of the shallow angle it is uncertain by about +-40 px along Harrison. The Westwood pipe, which runs north of Westwood's centre, joins the Harrison pipe at (3985,3325)
Schott (30 ft) ends at Westwood's south side, just inside the open mouth where Westwood merges with Harrison

Osterfeld (40 ft, printed OSTERFELD (NOT OPEN)) ends at Westwood's SE side about 100 px from the left paper edge; Westwood's NW face leaves the paper at (50,5244) and the block west of Osterfeld has a flat top at y about 5570, so the point is approximate (about +-25 px)

alleys.note: unnamed alley between Queen City and Westwood, west of Harrison: from Harrison (point on Harrison's centreline; mouth between the corners 1567,2430 and 1649,2523) WSW to an angle point at (565,2990)
same alley, west section (15 ft printed), nearly level, to a dead end at a lot line at x about 180-215 (does not reach the left edge)

bends.note: Harrison turns from running SSE (from Queen City) to running east; the north side is a long curve from (2290,2580) to (2900,3000)
angle point (corners at 769,4494 and 956,4835): west of it Westwood runs SW, steeper, to Osterfeld and the left edge
corridor centreline bends between x about 4000 and 4680 where its north line (P) and south line (R) kink at different places
Hiawatha (from the bottom edge, running NE) turns to run ESE to the right edge (drawn to x about 6445); corners at (6040,5845) and (6100,6095). Same bend as sheet 505 (2575,696)

ends.note: south end of Schott at the C.C.C.&St.L. railroad boundary
west end of the open corridor at the frame building (1 story) of the Bocherding planing mill lot, which occupies the strip from here to Harrison

notes: One panel only: no inset or separately framed part was found (the whole sheet was checked; the railroad-yard area at the bottom with Osterfeld and Hiawatha is continuous with the rest, e.g. Osterfeld meets Westwood, and the Harrison/Beekman to Hiawatha-bend distance and bearing agree with sheet 505). North is up (compass about 9 deg left of vertical). The dash-dot line A-B at the lower right (from about 6150,3770 down to 5740,7550) is the match line with sheet 505, which covers the area east of it. Names as printed: QUEEN CITY AV., HARRISON AV., WESTWOOD AV., PINETREE ST., PINE ALLEY, LAWNWAY, LAWN ALLEY, LICK RUN ALLEY, BEEKMAN, SCHOTT, OSTERFELD (NOT OPEN), HIAWATHA; Street added where no suffix is printed. LICK RUN ALLEY: between the rear lot lines of the Queen City lots (line P) and the Harrison lots (line R) there is one open corridor from the Bocherding lot (x about 2580) to Beekman. West of x about 4680 it is a single band 20-28 ft wide (block number 3 is printed in it) into which Pine Alley opens. East of x about 4680 an extra solid line (Q) splits it: the label LICK RUN ALLEY and 15' sit in the southern band Q-R, while the northern strip P-Q (about 20 ft, unmarked, no lot lines) lies against the Queen City lots and is where Lawn Alley ends; a lot line from the south runs up across R to Q's west end at x 4680. The picks treat the whole corridor P-R as Lick Run Alley; the strip P-Q may be the old Lick Run channel or a separate parcel. Queen City/Beekman (corner 1501 at 6461,111) and Queen City's crossing with Harrison's continuation beyond the sheets are not on the paper. Beekman's centreline runs along the right paper edge in the upper part of the sheet. Unlabelled band at the bottom centre (two parallel lines from about 2000-2370,7400 up to 3060-3130,6400-6670, ending at a line running SSE to 3400,7700): an unnamed road or lot outline, meets no named street. The C.C.C.&St.L. tracks, turntable and water tank are ignored.
